issues.title: [Shortcut Guide] Hold-Win activation throws NullReferenceException and shows nothing when the runner process cannot be inspected

en.headline: 15 own commits plus 19 automated commits across three repositories
en.summary: **15 own commits** were made across `sogeisetsu/dsh-ecosystem-report` and `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, plus 19 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/dsh-ecosystem-report`, 11 own commits improved mobile layouts for 375/414 viewports, replaced theme controls with a single-button popup and compact icon options, added an SVG favicon, a GitHub repository button, `LICENSE`, and `.gitattributes`, and refined visuals such as gradient top lines, KPI color bars, card title bars, zebra striping, and navigation underlines. The same repository's content changes merged three plugins into the resource-library list, corrected automation attribution, added a community installation combination, removed the suggestion-formation subsection, and documented repository and GitHub Pages publishing. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, 4 own commits updated agent documentation to remove historical worktree paths, drop the OpenChamber prerequisite, support external document sources with four evidence levels, and record memory-mechanism paths, `DSH run_code` dual channels, plugin package verification, and keyless search options. The user opened 1 issue in `microsoft/PowerToys`: #52004, titled "[Shortcut Guide] Hold-Win activation throws NullReferenceException and shows nothing when the runner process cannot be inspected".

zh.headline: 15 次本人提交，另有 19 次自动提交，分布于三个仓库
zh.summary: **15 次本人提交**分布在 `sogeisetsu/dsh-ecosystem-report` 和 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`，另有 19 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 自动提交。在 `sogeisetsu/dsh-ecosystem-report` 的 11 次本人提交中，改进了 375/414 视口下的移动端布局，将主题控件改为单按钮弹出菜单和紧凑图标选项，新增 SVG favicon、GitHub 仓库按钮、`LICENSE` 与 `.gitattributes`，并精修渐变顶线、KPI 色条、卡片标题条、斑马纹和导航下划线等视觉细节。该仓库的内容调整将 3 个插件并入资料库清单，修正 automation 归属，补充社区安装组合，删除建议的形成方式小节，并记录仓库与 GitHub Pages 发布说明。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 的 4 次本人提交中，更新了 agent 文档，清理工作树路径历史残留，移除 OpenChamber 前提，支持外部文档来源并采用四档证据等级，同时收录记忆机制链路、`DSH run_code` 双通道、插件包名核实和免 Key 搜索选型。用户新开了 1 个 `microsoft/PowerToys` issue：#52004，标题为 "[Shortcut Guide] Hold-Win activation throws NullReferenceException and shows nothing when the runner process cannot be inspected"。当日没有 pull request、review、release 或讨论记录。
